entry.title: Porchlamp Snapshot 2026-10-14 (Benchmark 2.0.0-rc1): 11,000 Open-Source Repositories Audited
entry.summary: Six-month empirical audit of 212,390 pull requests from 110,605 outside contributors across 11,000 repositories in npm, PyPI, crates.io, Go, Maven, and Systems. 3,833 repositories ranked, 5,790 gated at Stage 0 (including 1,133 pull-request black holes), and 1,377 unrated (<60% parameter coverage).

entry.title: Stars Don't Review Pull Requests: 26.4% of Active Open-Source Projects Are Black Holes
entry.summary: Of 4,297 licensed, maintained software projects receiving at least 10 outside pull requests in six months, 1,133 (26.4%) left most stranger pull requests with no human reply, review, or merge for 14 days. The black-hole share rises with star count: 21% at 1k–10k stars, 31% at 10k–50k, and 39% at 50k+ stars.

entry.title: Best Open-Source Projects for First-Time Contributors (1,968 Ranked Repositories)
entry.summary: Repositories re-weighted for first-time contributors: prioritizing fast Time to First Human Response, First-Timer Merge Rate, Active Good First Issues, Newcomer Conversion, and low 14-day PR Ghost Rate.

entry.title: Best Open-Source Projects for AI-Assisted Contributors (3,929 Ranked Repositories)
entry.summary: Repositories evaluated under the AI-Assisted contributor lens, combining explicit AI Policy Posture, automated CI/CD pipeline defenses, and maintainer responsiveness to outside pull requests.

entry.title: Leverage vs. Friction 2D Discovery Matrix (Sweet Spot, Crucible, Nursery, Low Priority)
entry.summary: Interactive two-dimensional mapping of ecosystem leverage (dependents, criticality, downloads) against contributor friction (response latency, ghost rate, governance barriers) to isolate Sweet Spot repositories.
